description: Upload a local video as extracted frames through the signed-upload flow for a dataset by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI. Defaults conflictPolicy to skip (the platform default is undocumented). Reports the queued job id with the dataset's current ingest status; use datasets_get to follow up.

dataset.description: Dataset ref by slug, owner/slug, or a ul://owner/datasets/slug URI.

fps.description: Maximum frame extraction rate in frames per second; may be reduced to keep the total within max_frames.

max_frames.description: Maximum number of frames to extract.

targetSplit.description: Target split for new images (overrides archive structure).

video_path.description: Local path to source video file.

name: dataset_upload_video
